note: Legal entity VELANKANI INFORMATION SYSTEMS PRIVATE LIMITED (Karnataka, Electronics City Bangalore) is real and active in customs data, but the only verified trade activity is inbound: machinery, sealant, desiccant, cutting tools from China (HS 82077010, 38249900, 32141000, 84778090, 84649000) — i.e. it behaves as an importer/buyer, not a confirmed exporter. The 'Buyers' list (Sri Lanka, Saudi Arabia, Russia) is a counterparty aggregation on the aggregator page and is NOT backed by any dated export B/L row I could see, so export is classified declared_only, not confirmed. Declared HS 850490 (power-supply parts) does not match any observed record; observed codes are unrelated to 850490 — per project rule this is not a rejection ground, code should be corrected to the actual traded codes. The trade names '46 OUNCES' / 'CAFE CAPRICCIO' have no traceable link to this legal entity in any source found — no shipment, tender or GST evidence ties those brands to Velankani; treat the name-to-entity mapping as unverified. Revenue and export volume: null (not public in accessible sources). No evidence of supply shipments under the claimed brand names found; no rejection grounds (entity exists, not liquidated/bankrupt).
